text:
Clare (PM): Heads up — milestone reset meeting tomorrow. We need to lock MVP scope to hit 2026-04-15 ship. Quick triage: tenant SSO + embedding freshness + tenant configs. Propose: defer tenant SSO to v1, reduce embedding freshness to 24h, drop live rerank. Thoughts? @Anil @Maya

Anil (Eng): Defer tenant SSO saves ~3 sprints of infra + security work. Agree. On embeddings: 24h cache is doable but I'll run cost/latency numbers today.

Maya (Product): :thumbsup: agree. Can we also drop live-search rerank from MVP? It's extra infra and test surface.

Luis (Design): Live-search rerank is a small UX win; we can ship without it and provide a placeholder interaction.

Sam (Analytics): If we cut rerank, add analytic events to measure later. I'll add events to the milestone tracker.

devops-bot: deploy-checker: There are 7 deploy blockers in staging for sso-integration. Link: https://ci.redwood.company/reports/1729

Anil (Eng): Quick numbers from sims: 24h embedding refresh reduces daily GPU hours by ~40% and cost by ~35%. Memory footprint unchanged. Biggest lift remains SSO + KMS integration.

Clare (PM): Decision proposal:
1) Defer tenant SSO to v1 (keep a gated pilot)
2) Embedding freshness -> 24h for MVP
3) Drop live rerank from MVP
4) Add telemetry gating + regression tests for quality
Anyone oppose?

Maya (Product): No objections. Request: keep a small canary for SSO pilot behind a flag so we can onboard 1 tenant.

Anil (Eng): We can do a gated pilot. Adding feature flag:
```
feature_gate.sso_pilot = false
```
Default false; can enable per-tenant.

Clare (PM): Locking it. I'll update milestone tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/milestones/IN-462 — ship target 2026-04-15. Owners: Anil (infra + flag), Maya (acceptance criteria), Luis (placeholder UX), Sam (analytics). @devops-bot please estimate infra SLA for dedicated capacity.

devops-bot: ops-bot: noted. Dedicated infra capacity estimate ETA: 6 business days. Queued request #INC-5282.

Clare (PM): :white_check_mark: I'll push the cutlist to roadmap and send stakeholder note after the meeting. Thanks all.
